note: Calculation registry (Calc Studio CS-a). One entry per computed endpoint: what it computes (formula), what it reads (inputs.catalog must resolve via services/catalog.py; inputs.parameters must exist in the governed parameter store), and how the runner invokes it (endpoint/args/summary_keys). scenario_capable marks the handlers that read governed parameters via get_param and therefore respond to scenario overrides (CS-c).

calculations.name: CSA RAB shares, PCT buy-in & true-up
calculations.description: Cost Sharing Arrangement model for participants 1000/3100/3800: cost pool, reasonably-anticipated-benefit (RAB) shares from growth-projected sales, in-period true-ups and the PCT platform buy-in — all aggregated from segment_pl so it reconciles with the segmented P&L by construction.
calculations.formula: pool = Σ opex_rd; projected_sales_i = revenue_i × (1 + growth); rab_share_i = projected_sales_i / Σ projected_sales; true_up_i = rab_share_i × pool − opex_rd_i; pct_buyin_i = rab_share_i × (pct_mult × pool)
calculations.output: CSA model: pool, platform_value, per-participant rab_share / target_contribution / true_up / pct_buyin (Σ true_up = 0).

calculations.name: Residual profit split
calculations.description: Residual profit split across the non-routine parties (1000 US IP, 3100 CH IP, 3000 DE Manufacturer): combined operating profit from segment_pl allocated by the selected value-driver key (opex_rd default, sga alternative), with per-party true-ups.
calculations.formula: combined_profit = Σ operating_profit; share_i = key_i / Σ key (key = opex_rd | sga); allocated_i = share_i × combined_profit; true_up_i = allocated_i − operating_profit_i
calculations.output: Profit-split model: combined_profit, key_total, per-participant residual_share / allocated_profit / true_up.

calculations.name: BEAT §59A base-erosion computation
calculations.description: US payer (1000) base-erosion prep: the real related-party deductible base from journal RASSC lines, classified to payment types by the governed RACCT map, tested against the 3% threshold, with modified taxable income and the 10% BEAT base tax. Includes the per-CFC Schedule M rollup.
calculations.formula: base_eroding = Σ related-party deductions (journal HSL<0, RASSC set) excluding COGS-type accounts; base_erosion_pct = 100 × base_eroding / total_deductions; MTI = (gross_receipts − total_deductions) + base_eroding; beat_base_tax = MTI × rate_pct / 100
calculations.output: BEAT model: base_eroding_payments, base_erosion_pct vs threshold, modified_taxable_income, beat_base_tax, payment-type and per-account splits, Schedule M.

calculations.name: IC loan & cash-pool interest accrual
calculations.description: Arm's-length interest on the (fabricated) IC loan register and cash pool: per-loan annual interest from the all-in rate (flagged against the BM-FIN CUP band) and per-seat pool interest from the deposit/borrow spread.
calculations.formula: loan: annual_interest = principal × all_in_rate / 100, within_benchmark = BM-FIN.lower ≤ all_in_rate ≤ BM-FIN.upper; pool seat: annual_interest = balance × spread / 100; net_position = Σ balances
calculations.output: Loan register + cash pool with computed annual interest, benchmark flags and rolled-up totals.

calculations.name: Withholding tax on IC payments
calculations.description: Per-corridor withholding tax on IC royalty + service payments: the gross withholdable base from supply_chain (real), joined to the bilateral treaty-rate seed to compute treaty WHT due and the saving versus the statutory fallback.
calculations.formula: per corridor (source→residence, payment type): gross = Σ TOTAL_LEGAL_PRICE; wht_due = gross × treaty_rate / 100; treaty_saving = gross × (statutory_rate − treaty_rate) / 100
calculations.output: Per-corridor WHT rows (gross, treaty/statutory rate, wht_due, treaty_saving) + totals.

calculations.name: ERP ↔ TP reconciliation
calculations.description: Per-flow reconciliation keyed by AWREF: the planned IC price book (supply_chain) joined to what actually posted in ACDOCA (journal), classifying each flow as reconciled / unposted / value-break / challenged against the governed tolerance.
calculations.formula: posted(AWREF) = MAX(|HSL|) over the document's journal lines; delta = posted − planned; status = challenged → unposted (no posting) → value-break (|delta| > tolerance) → reconciled
calculations.output: Reconciliation rows per AWREF (planned, posted, delta, status) + summary counts and planned/posted/delta totals.

calculations.name: Latest-Estimate forecast
calculations.description: Full-year Latest Estimate per tested party: segment_pl actuals-to-date projected by run-rate for the unposted months, with the resulting full-year margin tested against each entity's arm's-length band from entity_roles. The governed pl.use_post_charge toggle (Phase 5 W2) resolves the P&L basis — when true and a waterfall run is applied, the FY overlay folds into the Latest Estimate.
calculations.formula: run_rate = actuals_to_date / months_posted; LE = actuals_to_date + run_rate × months_remaining (+ applied waterfall overlay when pl=post_charge); status = band(LE margin vs OM_LOW_PCT..OM_HIGH_PCT)
calculations.output: Per-party LE workpaper: actuals, forecast remainder, full-year revenue/profit/margin, target band and projected in/watch/out status.

calculations.name: Stewardship cost exclusion
calculations.description: Shareholder/stewardship review of the parent (1000/3100) G&A cost base: the real opex_ga base from segment_pl screened against the fabricated candidate-line register; lines flagged stewardship are excluded from the chargeable base (OECD TPG 7.9-7.10).
calculations.formula: cost_base = Σ parent opex_ga (segment_pl); excluded = Σ candidate lines flagged stewardship; adjusted_cost_base = cost_base − excluded
calculations.output: Cost base per parent, excluded stewardship total and the adjusted chargeable cost base, with the screened candidate lines.

calculations.name: IC transaction flow rollup
calculations.description: The IC flow universe: supply_chain grouped by material type, seller/buyer role and TP method into policy rows with YTD volume, chain counts and APA/challenged status.
calculations.formula: GROUP supply_chain BY (MATERIAL_TYPE, SELLER_ROLE, BUYER_ROLE, TP_METHOD): ytd_volume = Σ TOTAL_LEGAL_PRICE; status = out-of-range if challenged, watch if APA, else in-range
calculations.output: One row per flow family (type, roles, method, YTD volume, status).

calculations.name: Royalty register
calculations.description: Per-licence royalty register: ROYALTY rows in supply_chain grouped by licensor/licensee/IP, with the average rate, YTD fees and a benchmark-range check.
calculations.formula: GROUP supply_chain WHERE MATERIAL_TYPE='ROYALTY' BY (IP_OWNER, SELLING_COMPANY, BUYING_COMPANY, MATNR, TP_METHOD): rate = AVG(MARKUP_RATE) × 100; ytd_fees = Σ TOTAL_LEGAL_PRICE; band = rate ± 1.5pp
calculations.output: One row per licence (licensor, licensee, IP category, rate %, YTD fees, benchmark range).

calculations.name: Price-setting rows vs benchmark bands
calculations.description: Settable per-material price rows for the goods & services price-setting wizards (OTP-1/2/4): supply_chain aggregated per chain + material with standard cost, cost-plus markup and the benchmarking band the row tests against (BM-SVC / BM-LRD / BM-TOLL).
calculations.formula: GROUP supply_chain BY (CHAIN_ID, MATERIAL_TYPE): markup = AVG(MARKUP_RATE) × 100; band = BM-SVC if SERVICE else BM-LRD if buyer is LRD else BM-TOLL; within = band.lower ≤ markup ≤ band.upper
calculations.output: One settable price row per chain + material (cost, markup %, total legal price, benchmark band + within flag).

calculations.name: IC invoice synthesis
calculations.description: Synthesized IC invoices: one invoice per (seller, buyer, period, material type) bucket of supply_chain, with amount, cost base, implied blended markup and a period-bucketed status; submitted TP adjustments are prepended from app state.
calculations.formula: GROUP supply_chain BY (SELLING_COMPANY, BUYING_COMPANY, GJAHR, POPER, MATERIAL_TYPE): amount = Σ TOTAL_LEGAL_PRICE; cost_base = Σ STANDARD_COST × TOTAL_VOLUME; markup = (amount − cost_base) / cost_base
calculations.output: Invoice list (payor, payee, type, amount, status per period bucket) including submitted adjustments.

calculations.name: Segmented P&L extract
calculations.description: The segmented monthly P&L rows behind OTP-20/21 and the dashboard: segment_pl per entity/segment/period with the full cost-line breakdown, optionally filtered by entity/period/year.
calculations.formula: SELECT segment_pl rows (revenue, cogs, opex_*, ic_charges, depreciation, operating_profit, operating_margin) WHERE entity/period/year filters ORDER BY RBUKRS, GJAHR, POPER
calculations.output: Monthly segmented P&L rows per entity (the aggregation base most calcs reconcile against).

calculations.name: Berry ratio trend
calculations.description: Monthly Berry ratio (gross profit / operating expenses) for an entity or the LRD aggregate (3200/3300/3800), plotted against the target ratio band line.
calculations.formula: per month: gp = revenue − cogs − opex_production − ic_charges; opex = opex_rd + opex_sm + opex_ga + opex_dist; berry = gp / opex vs target
calculations.output: Monthly rows (revenue, gp, opex, berry, target) for the trend chart.

calculations.name: Intercompany service cost allocation
calculations.description: The deterministic cost-to-charge allocation engine (docs/allocation/SPEC.md): GL cost lines are classified, pooled, gated for the benefit test, apportioned by allocation keys (largest remainder; cascade/reciprocal aware), marked up per pool-and-jurisdiction policy, charged out and reconciled to a zero residual. A registry run launches the POST-equivalent actual run for the latest demo period; outputs land on the append-only allocation ledgers with a per-run documentation pack.
calculations.formula: capture/classify → pool → benefit-test gate → allocate (largest remainder over key ratios) → cost base + markup (per pool × jurisdiction regime) → charge-out (FX logged) → reconcile: pooled − exclusions − recovered = 0
calculations.output: Run summary (run_id, charges, recon Balanced/Break, output hash) + the 7 stage summaries; charge ledger / recon rows / doc pack persist on the allocation run itself.
